chapter: Mutes, influences and the blues singers
title: Ranking Clara, Mamie and Trixie Smith
summary: Clara was loud and good but below Bessie, Mamie was nice but never took with the public, and Trixie was mediocre.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: What was Clara like? Was she the same sort of person as Bessie? Or was she different?

No, well now Clara was -- Clara was loud, but smaller, and good. Oh yes, she could sing. but I mean she didn't hit the top like Bessie. Everybody liked -- I think Bessie was -- got great buxom voice there, that could go (Sings) We-e-e-l-l, this is Bessie, so and so, you know.
And she looked the part, too.
And she looked the part. And Clara was a little smaller, but she was good.
Was she the second best of the Smiths, would you say?
I think so, yes.
How about Trixie? Where did you --
Oh, I forgot Mamie.
Oh -- oh, yeah, Mamie.

Yeah, Mamie -- Mamie wasn't bad, but Mamie -- I don't know. The public didn't take to Mamie like they did to Bessie -- not Clara. You know, not -- she was good though. She -- sure. She was allright. But she didn't take good.
Did Mamie have a voice sort of like Bessie's? That --
Like Bessie's?
-- big kind of voice?
No, it was different. And she let you know, 'I'm the most beautiful one of the Smiths. I'm the only Smith. I'm Clara.' She'd preach that. I mean she'd say that anywhere. And back it up.
And when she opened her mouth you could have heard her, I mean, you know, and she was -- she was -- I'm sorry I don't have -- I had a good chance. I don't have a recording
of Clara. And right now I don't have anything of Bessie. My wife had some, and my mother give them away. She didn't know anything about it.
How about Trixie? What was she like?

Well Trixie was -- well, I don't like to use this -- say the word. She was mediocre. She was a nice person, very nice, but she wasn't the singer that neither Clara nor Bessie were. She never would be.
Or Mamie either?
Huh?
Or Mamie either?
Ah, Mamie was -- no. No, no, now I got to -- no. I have to say it. Mamie was nice. She was good, nice, but she wasn't -- she wasn't a Bessie, and she wasn't a Clara.
